description:
See what your nail business really earns after supplies, chair rent and fees. Log each appointment and tip (cash or card); the tracker works out your profit, profit per hour for every service, what to reorder and what to set aside for tax. Any currency, any country.

See more of our Self-Employed Finance tools here: https://www.etsy.com/shop/WayofWealthStudio?section_id=57077419
See the rest of our shop here: https://www.etsy.com/shop/WayofWealthStudio
Track every business cost with our best seller, the Self Employed Expense Tracker: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4475265519
Want the full set? Our Self Employed Tax Toolkit Bundle: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4517461053

WHAT'S INSIDE (11 TABS)
- Dashboard: 8 cards, 5 charts and your next steps (reorder, raise a price, top up the tax pot)
- Client Log with tips by cash and card, Expenses in 16 nail categories, Supplies & Stock with reorder levels
- Rent & Bills (plus a renting vs commission check), Monthly Summary, Pricing Check, Tax Set-Aside
- Monthly money check-in with guided reflection questions: your month in plain words

WHY BUYERS SWITCH TO THIS ONE
- A real .xlsx file: it opens in Excel and Google Sheets, never in Canva
- Built from cells only, so nothing goes missing in Google Sheets
- Formulas are locked with no password, so you can always unlock and edit
- A filled-in example plus a blank file, clearly named
- Questions answered by Joel, a qualified financial planner, through Etsy messages

DETAILS
Digital download: EXAMPLE .xlsx, BLANK .xlsx and README PDF. Works in Excel 2016+ and Google Sheets (free); in Sheets, move between tabs with the tab bar. Download it from You > Purchases. Nothing is posted. The tax set-aside is a simple percentage you choose, not tax advice.

Photos use AI-made studio scenes; the product shown on the screens is the real file you download.
